build.module: The crate schema-forge-quill, [package.metadata.schema-forge] role = "engine" and database = "quill", depending on schema-forge-model, schema-forge-engine and serde_json only; a comment in it says Quill is no real database, ships in no build, and is registered for tests by the test-engines feature of schema-forge-engines.

module.public: Quill (with new and broken), Broken, the constants RECORD, HOOK and KEY; nothing else
module.step: crates/engine/tests/example/mod.rs becomes engines/quill/src/lib.rs: the type Example becomes Quill, its id `quill` and its name `Quill`; its versions `1` and `2`, named `Quill 1` and `Quill 2`; its files start `quill <version>` where they started `example <version>`, so reads gives `Quill files`, recognises a head starting `quill `, and the writer writes `quill <version>`; the module's documentation says what Quill is and why it is unlike MySQL. Every Broken variant stays, and two are added (steps 3 and 5).

Its kinds are RECORD, `record` (name Record, Slot::Keys) and HOOK, `hook` (name Hook, Slot::Trigger), where it had table and trigger; its files still write them `table` and `trigger`; its option `fast` is for the kind record. Broken::UnknownKind still reads its tables as `sheet`.

Its connection fields are `endpoint` (Endpoint, a path, required: the Quill file that is the database), `passphrase` (Passphrase, the secret) and `mode` (Mode, one of safe and fast, default safe); the broken copies' fields are renamed the same way. KEY is `open-quill`. test(profile, secret): the step reach passes when the endpoint's file can be read, else fails naming the path and the error; secure passes in mode safe and is a warning in mode fast; sign in passes when the secret is KEY, else fails with `the passphrase does not open it`; version passes when the file's first line is `quill ` and one of its versions, else fails; rights passes with `a passphrase only reads`; after a failure the steps not tried are skipped. read(profile, secret, which): the endpoint's file read as a file is read, refused with `the passphrase does not open it` without KEY; with which given, only its shelves (namespaces) and their objects and links are kept, and a shelf which names that the file lacks is the error `there is no shelf <name>`, in backquotes.

Quill implements Tables (t02): files() is engines/quill/schema/quill__record_options.sql, embedded, by its name; integrity() is engines/quill/schema/integrity.sql; migrations() is empty; rows() writes a row of quill__record_options, id the record's id and fast 1, for every object whose section's option fast is true, and the error of t02 step 5 for any other option; read() sets fast true on the object of each such row.
Broken::TablesLose: read() sets no option, so the kit's round trip finds the record that lost fast.

build.module: crates/engine/tests/interface.rs, moved: `use schema_forge_quill::{Broken, Quill};` for the module example, every name and expected message following steps 1 to 5 (the kit's own messages unchanged), the samples moved to engines/quill/tests/samples as shop.quill and machinery.quill (were shop.example and machinery.example) and other.txt, the paths in the tests following them, the first line of shop.quill and machinery.quill `quill 2`. crates/engine/tests/interface.rs, crates/engine/tests/example and crates/engine/tests/samples are removed.

module.public: registry() and, under the feature test-engines, for_tests(); nothing else
module.step: The crate schema-forge-engines, role registry: registry() is a Registry with MySQL; for_tests(), compiled only with its feature test-engines (which brings schema-forge-quill as an optional dependency), is registry() with Quill beside it, Quill last. Its manifest's comment says no build ships Quill.

A second test of the workspace, shared_code_names_no_engine_word, with schema-forge-engines (feature test-engines) and schema-forge-engine as dev-dependencies of tools/architecture: the engine words are, for every engine of for_tests(), its live part's field keys, its kinds' ids, its options' keys, and the table and column names its Tables files declare (each CREATE TABLE's name and its column definitions' names); the shared words are the table and column names of schema/cortex and schema/workspace and every field name of a pub struct of crates/model and crates/engine/src/sections.rs; a word that is both is shared. Every .rs file under src/ of every crate of role model, interface or app (its tests under tests/ are kept engine-neutral by running on every engine, root method tests), comment lines aside, holding an engine word that is not shared as a whole string literal ("word") or read as a member (.word not followed by an opening parenthesis: a method call is not a member) is the breach `<path>:<line>: names <word>, a word of <engine>; shared code shows what an engine declares and never names it`, and the test fails listing every breach. The merged unit tests of crates/engine/src/live.rs name the field keys host, port and user, which are MySQL's: they are renamed there to place, door and who, the only change to that file, so the guard passes on the merged code.

The registry's items are tests in crates/engines/src/lib.rs, run with --features test-engines. The vocabulary guard's item is a unit test of tools/architecture's own on texts of its own beside the workspace test of step 7, which runs on the repository.
tests.prove: Quill passes the conformance kit on its samples, its tables' round trip included
Quill's kinds are record and hook, its files still writing table and trigger
with a wrong passphrase the test passes reach and secure, fails sign in and skips version and rights, and no step says the secret
read with the passphrase gives the schema the file's read gives, which keeps only the shelves named, and a shelf the file lacks is the error naming it
a record written fast is a row of quill__record_options and comes back fast; any other option is the error naming it
the kit finds the round trip of Broken::TablesLose losing fast
registry() holds MySQL alone and for_tests() MySQL then Quill

shared code naming an engine's field key, kind id, option key, table or column as a string or a member is a breach naming the file, the line, the word and its engine, and a word the cortex or the model also uses is none
